messages.text:
I can't refund either item.

**Toaster:** This policy only covers items from orders you placed with this shop (refund-policy/v2/scope). I can't refund something you bought on another store's website.

**Ceramic butter dish (order h427-o1):** The shop's records show it was delivered on 2026-10-12 and that we received it back. A refund must be requested within 30 days of delivery (refund-policy/v2/window). Your deadline was 2026-11-11 10:00 UTC, so a request now is too late. The policy has no exceptions to the time limit, so I can't propose a refund for it.

**What the policy covers:**
- Only delivered orders qualify (refund-policy/v2/eligible-orders).
- Items must be received back by the shop first (refund-policy/v2/return).
- The refund is what you paid for each unit. Shipping isn't included (refund-policy/v2/amount, refund-policy/v2/shipping).
- Each unit is refunded once (refund-policy/v2/remaining).
- Refunds go only to the original payment (refund-policy/v2/payment).
- You confirm the proposal with the button, and a staff member approves it (refund-policy/v2/approval).
